brand.title: Services — INU Media | Ideas into Impact
brand.description: A full suite of creative and digital services: marketing, design, video, performance, social media, PR, web and strategy. Ideas into impact, with INU Media.

hero.heading: Ideas
hero.description: A 360° creative & digital agency built to grow brands.

services.heading: A full suite
services.description: From strategy to execution, we help brands show up sharper, louder and better — across every platform. Here’s how we make it happen.

items.title: Digital marketing
items.tagline: Strategy-driven marketing to grow your brand online.
items.summary: One plan for everywhere your audience scrolls, searches and talks. We connect social, search, paid and reputation so every channel pushes the same story forward, and every rupee can be traced back to what it did.

offerings.name: Social Media Marketing
offerings.line: Platform-native content and campaigns built around how your audience actually uses each feed.

offerings.name: Performance Marketing
offerings.line: Paid campaigns planned around a number, optimised every week and reported plainly.

offerings.name: SEO / SEM
offerings.line: Search visibility that compounds: technical fixes, content that ranks and ads that catch intent.

offerings.name: Online Reputation Management
offerings.line: Reviews, mentions and search results watched, answered and shaped before they shape you.

items.title: Design & creative
items.tagline: Designs that don’t just look good, but make an impact.
items.summary: Identity, packaging, print and the everyday creative that carries a brand. We build visual systems that stay recognisable from a hoarding down to a story frame, then hand them over so your team can keep them sharp.

offerings.name: Graphic Design
offerings.line: Campaign, social and print layouts with one consistent hand behind them.

offerings.name: Brand Identity
offerings.line: Logo, type, colour and voice, assembled into a system with rules people can follow.

offerings.name: Creatives & A+ Content
offerings.line: Marketplace listings and A+ pages designed to answer questions and close the sale.

offerings.name: Print Design
offerings.line: Packaging, brochures, outdoor and on-ground collateral, prepared properly for press.

items.title: Video production & VFX
items.summary: Script to screen under one roof. We write, shoot, cut and finish, with VFX and CGI done in house, so a film keeps its idea intact from the first storyboard frame to the last export.

offerings.name: Video Ads
offerings.line: Short, hook-first ads cut for each platform’s length, ratio and sound-off viewing.

offerings.name: VFX & CGI
offerings.line: Compositing, 3D and product visualisation finished by our own post team.

offerings.name: Brand Films
offerings.line: Longer stories about who you are, directed to be watched to the end.

offerings.name: Reels & Short Content
offerings.line: A steady stream of vertical content, shot in batches and edited for the feed.

items.title: Performance marketing
items.tagline: Data-backed campaigns for real business results.
items.summary: Campaigns built backwards from the result you need: leads, sales or installs. We plan the funnel, make the creative and landing pages to match, and keep adjusting until the cost per result is one worth reporting.

offerings.name: Paid Ads (Meta, Google, YouTube)
offerings.line: Account structure, audiences and creative testing on the platforms that matter to you.

offerings.name: Campaign Strategy
offerings.line: Budgets, stages and targets agreed before a rupee is spent.

offerings.name: Lead Generation
offerings.line: Forms, landing pages and follow-ups that bring in enquiries your sales team wants.

offerings.name: Conversion Optimization
offerings.line: Pages and journeys tested and refined, so more of the traffic you pay for converts.

items.title: Social media management
items.tagline: Complete handling of your brand’s social presence.
items.summary: Strategy before posting. We audit where you stand, define who you are talking to, plan the calendar and run the channels day to day: content, replies, creators and all.

offerings.name: Content Planning
offerings.line: Monthly calendars built on pillars, moments and what your audience responds to.

offerings.name: Post Creation & Scheduling
offerings.line: Design, copy and edits produced in batches and published on time.

offerings.name: Community Management
offerings.line: Comments and DMs answered in your voice, with problems flagged early.

offerings.name: Influencer Collaboration
offerings.line: Creators matched to the brief, briefed properly and tracked to results.

items.title: PR & branding
items.summary: Coverage and positioning that make people take a brand seriously. We shape the story, take it to the press and creators who matter, and keep your name in the right rooms, from film releases to product launches.

offerings.name: Media Outreach
offerings.line: Releases and pitches placed with the publications and journalists that fit the story.

offerings.name: Brand Positioning
offerings.line: A clear point of view on who you are for, and why that matters.

offerings.name: Celebrity & Influencer PR
offerings.line: A pan-India network of personalities and creators for launches and campaigns.

offerings.name: Event Promotion
offerings.line: Buzz before, coverage during and content after every event.

items.title: Web & tech solutions
items.summary: Websites designed to look sharp and built to perform. From a single landing page to a multi-page store, we handle design, development, speed and SEO, and stay on to keep it running.

offerings.name: Website Design & Development
offerings.line: Custom sites designed around your brand, fast, responsive and easy to update.

offerings.name: Landing Pages
offerings.line: Focused single pages for campaigns, launches and lead capture.

offerings.name: UI/UX Design
offerings.line: Journeys, wireframes and interfaces tested for clarity before anything is built.

offerings.name: Web Maintenance
offerings.line: Updates, backups, security and small changes, handled without the wait.

items.title: Strategy & consulting
items.tagline: The roadmap behind every successful brand.
items.summary: The thinking before the making. We study your market, your audience and your competitors, then turn it into a plan the whole team, and every partner, can work from.

offerings.name: Brand Strategy
offerings.line: Positioning, architecture and messaging that give every decision a reference point.

offerings.name: Content Strategy
offerings.line: What to say, where, how often and why, mapped to the business goal.

offerings.name: Market Research
offerings.line: Audience, category and competitor insight gathered before we commit to an idea.

offerings.name: 360° Campaign Planning
offerings.line: One campaign idea carried across film, social, performance, PR and on-ground.

services,
